$comment: The 0.20 catalogue: furniture, lighting, decor, kids' and garden things for every room, from cheap to premium. Models are in assets/manifest.json and the packs it lists (tools/art/blender/families/). `layer` puts things on a wall, the ceiling or the floor's surface (rugs), where they take no floor space; `bunk` makes a bed's second slot the upper bunk. Feelings are prefixed `home.`.

objects.name: Mini fridge
objects.description: A small fridge for a small kitchen (or a bedroom corner): snacks and simple meals, but no room for a gourmet spread.

objects.name: Counter-depth fridge
objects.description: A tall counter-depth fridge-freezer, the freezer below and a water dispenser in the door. Plenty of fresh food: bigger snacks, fuller meals and a cold drink.

objects.name: Electric cooker
objects.description: A freestanding cooker with four rings and an oven. Cooking here trains Cooking; good cooks get more out of every meal.

objects.name: Gas range
objects.description: Six flames and a big oven for serious cooks. From Cooking 3 a gourmet dinner leaves residents with that home-cooked glow.

objects.name: Microwave counter
objects.description: A counter with a microwave on top: hot leftovers in a few minutes, no skill needed.

objects.name: Coffee machine
objects.description: A counter with a bean-to-cup machine. A fresh coffee perks residents up and slows their tiredness for a few hours.

objects.name: Breakfast counter
objects.description: A counter with a toaster and a blender: toast for a quick bite, a smoothie for a little energy.

objects.name: Dishwasher
objects.description: Built in under the worktop. Loading it is a quick, satisfying chore (the tidy love it).

objects.name: Kitchen counter
objects.description: A base cabinet with a worktop. Line them up for a proper kitchen; there's always room to make a sandwich.

objects.name: Corner counter
objects.description: A deep corner unit that joins two runs of counters into an L.

objects.name: Farmhouse sink
objects.description: A deep apron-front sink with a gooseneck tap: wash up after cooking, or just your hands.

objects.name: Pantry cupboard
objects.description: A tall cupboard stocked with crackers, fruit and jars: a snack without opening the fridge.

objects.name: Wall cabinets
objects.description: Two-door cabinets that hang on the wall above the worktop. They make a kitchen look finished.

objects.name: Cooker hood
objects.description: A chimney hood for the wall above the stove.

objects.name: Kitchen island
objects.description: A freestanding island with cupboards at the front and a worktop overhanging the back for stools: two residents can make a snack or have breakfast here at once.

objects.name: Bar stool
objects.description: A tall stool for the counter or the island.

objects.name: Bistro table
objects.description: A little round table with one chair: the cheapest place to sit down for breakfast or a coffee.

objects.name: Glass dining table
objects.description: A glass-topped table for two with chairs: breakfast and coffee in style.

objects.name: Farmhouse dining table
objects.description: A solid oak table set for four. Lingering over a long meal here is the best part of the day.

objects.name: Dining chair
objects.description: A simple chair: extra seating anywhere.

objects.name: Loveseat
objects.description: A compact two-seater sofa.

objects.name: Three-seat sofa
objects.description: A long, deep sofa with soft cushions: very comfortable, and good for a doze.

objects.name: Designer sofa
objects.description: A low, sculpted sofa that makes a room. The most comfortable seat in the house, and a pleasure to look at.

objects.name: Lounge chair
objects.description: A simple upholstered armchair.

objects.name: Leather armchair
objects.description: Leather cushions on a solid wooden frame.

objects.name: Executive lounge chair
objects.description: A high-backed swivel chair in padded leather on a chrome five-star base. Sinking into it leaves residents feeling at home.

objects.name: Leather pouf
objects.description: A footstool that doubles as a seat.

objects.name: Coffee table
objects.description: A low table with a few magazines on it.

objects.name: Glass coffee table
objects.description: A glass-topped coffee table.

objects.name: Round marble coffee table
objects.description: A round marble top on a brass pedestal, at coffee-table height.

objects.name: Side table
objects.description: A small table for beside the sofa.

objects.name: Flat-screen TV
objects.description: A big, thin screen that hangs on the wall, with a soundbar: better TV than the old set, and it takes no floor space.

objects.name: Console TV
objects.description: An old television in a wooden console on legs, rabbit ears on top. It still works (mostly).

objects.name: Home cinema
objects.description: A huge screen, tower speakers and a media unit. Watching a whole film here leaves residents with a movie-night glow.

objects.name: Stereo system
objects.description: A radio and two speakers on a low cabinet: put a record on, or dance.

objects.name: Boombox
objects.description: A cassette boombox on a crate.

objects.name: Low bookcase
objects.description: Two shelves of paperbacks: a good read, but not for serious study.

objects.name: Library bookcase
objects.description: A wall of books. Studying from it trains Intelligence faster, and the house finally looks well read.

objects.name: Industrial shelving
objects.description: Steel and wood shelves with books, plants and drawers.

objects.name: Single bed
objects.description: A bed for one.

objects.name: Bunk bed
objects.description: Two beds, one above the other, in the floor space of one: two residents sleep in it.

objects.name: King futon
objects.description: A low platform with a firm king-size futon: the cheapest big bed, if not the comfiest. Folded, it is a deep sofa.

objects.name: Upholstered king bed
objects.description: A tall padded headboard and layers of bedding. A full night here leaves residents well rested: more energy and comfort from everything for hours.

objects.name: Nightstand
objects.description: A bedside table with a drawer.

objects.name: Nightstand with lamp
objects.description: A bedside table with a reading lamp: light for the bedroom at night.

objects.name: Chest of drawers
objects.description: Six drawers of clothes. Picking a good outfit makes residents more charming for a few hours.

objects.name: Wardrobe
objects.description: A double wardrobe. Picking a good outfit makes residents more charming for a few hours.

objects.name: Dressing table
objects.description: A table with a mirror and a pouf: freshen up, practise a smile, look your best.

objects.name: Wall mirror
objects.description: A mirror for the wall: check your look, or practise a speech.

objects.name: Compact toilet
objects.description: A basic toilet. Cheap, but it wears out faster.

objects.name: Smart toilet
objects.description: A wall-hung toilet with a warm seat and a bidet: a little fresher and comfier every time.

objects.name: Bathtub
objects.description: A long soak gets residents clean and comfortable.

objects.name: Clawfoot tub
objects.description: A deep freestanding tub on brass feet. A soak leaves residents pampered: they stay fresh for longer.

objects.name: Shower stall
objects.description: A tiled corner with a curtain: cheap, cheerful and a bit slow.

objects.name: Walk-in rain shower
objects.description: A stone floor, a glass screen and a big rain head. A quick, invigorating shower that leaves residents refreshed.

objects.name: Pedestal sink
objects.description: A simple basin on a pedestal.

objects.name: Double vanity
objects.description: Two basins side by side: no more queueing to brush your teeth. Hang a mirror above it.

objects.name: Mirror cabinet
objects.description: A mirrored cabinet for above the basin.

objects.name: Towel rail
objects.description: Fresh towels on the wall.

objects.name: Washing machine
objects.description: Clean clothes help a little with hygiene, and the tidy love doing the laundry.

objects.name: Tumble dryer
objects.description: Warm, fresh laundry to fold.

objects.name: Kids' bed
objects.description: A small bed with a guard rail and stars on the headboard.

objects.name: Toy box
objects.description: Blocks, balls and odds and ends. Children love it; grown-ups rarely play on their own.

objects.name: Play mat
objects.description: A soft mat with building blocks.

objects.name: Chalkboard easel
objects.description: A child-sized chalkboard: drawing trains Creativity.

objects.name: Doll house
objects.description: A two-storey doll house with tiny furniture.

objects.name: Rocking horse
objects.description: Giddy-up!

objects.name: Kids' desk
objects.description: A small desk and chair for homework and drawings.

objects.name: Giant teddy bear
objects.description: A big, soft bear to hug.

objects.name: Writing desk
objects.description: A plain desk with a lamp, paper and pens: writing trains Writing, and pupils do their homework here.

objects.name: Laptop desk
objects.description: A small desk with a laptop: browse, write or code without the price of a full computer desk.

objects.name: Gaming PC
objects.description: Two screens, a glowing keyboard and a fast tower. Games are more fun the better the player (Dexterity); from Dexterity 3 a win leaves them sharp.

objects.name: Office chair
objects.description: A swivel chair on castors.

objects.name: Ukulele
objects.description: Four strings and a cheerful sound: strumming builds Creativity; from Creativity 3 residents play so well they're in tune for hours.

objects.name: Electric guitar
objects.description: A solid-body guitar and an amp. Practice builds Creativity and Dexterity; from Creativity 3 a jam leaves residents in tune.

objects.name: Digital piano
objects.description: A slim keyboard on a stand with a bench: piano practice for a smaller room and budget.

objects.name: Pool table
objects.description: A full-size table with balls and a cue. A game for two that trains Perception and Dexterity.

objects.name: Foosball table
objects.description: Spin the rods and score: quick fun for two.

objects.name: Dartboard
objects.description: A dartboard for the wall: a few throws train Perception.

objects.name: Sewing table
objects.description: A sewing machine on a little table: sewing builds Dexterity and Creativity, and mending is a useful chore.

objects.name: Chemistry bench
objects.description: Flasks, a microscope and a shelf of reagents: experiments train Intelligence and Perception.

objects.name: Exercise bike
objects.description: A basic upright bike: cycling builds Endurance.

objects.name: Yoga mat
objects.description: A mat, a block and a bottle of water. Yoga stretches the body and calms the mind.

objects.name: Dumbbell rack
objects.description: Eight dumbbells on a rack: lifting builds Strength.

objects.name: Framed print
objects.description: A typographic print in a white frame.

objects.name: Photo print
objects.description: A black-and-white city photograph.

objects.name: Oil painting
objects.description: A landscape in oils in a gilded frame. Residents stop to admire it.

objects.name: Abstract canvas
objects.description: A big canvas of bold colour blocks.

objects.name: Wall clock
objects.description: A clean, round clock.

objects.name: Floating shelves
objects.description: Two shelves of books, a plant and a photo.

objects.name: Curtains
objects.description: A pair of curtains on a rod: hang them over a window.

objects.name: Floor-length curtains
objects.description: Long curtains for a wide window or a tall room.

objects.name: Round rug
objects.description: A round rug: furniture can stand on it.

objects.name: Large area rug
objects.description: A big rug to pull a seating area together.

objects.name: Hall runner
objects.description: A long, narrow rug for a hall.

objects.name: Patterned rug
objects.description: A woven rug with a border and medallions.

objects.name: Grandfather clock
objects.description: A tall clock with a pendulum. Someone has to wind it.

objects.name: Tall vase
objects.description: A slim ceramic vase with dried stems.

objects.name: Porcelain urn
objects.description: A blue-and-white porcelain jar.

objects.name: Vase on a pedestal
objects.description: A blue glazed vase of white flowers on its own plinth.

objects.name: Marble bust
objects.description: A classical bust on a plinth. Residents stop to admire it.

objects.name: Cat statue
objects.description: A concrete cat, indoors or out.

objects.name: Bronze horse
objects.description: A bronze horse on an oak plinth, its head up.

objects.name: Coat stand
objects.description: Somewhere for coats and hats by the door.

objects.name: Hanging plant
objects.description: Trailing greenery in a hanging pot.

objects.name: Fireplace
objects.description: A real fire under a mantel. It lights the room at night, and warming up by it leaves residents cosy.

objects.name: Pendant lamp
objects.description: A frosted globe on a long cord.

objects.name: Lantern pendant
objects.description: A frosted square lantern on a short stem from the ceiling.

objects.name: Ring chandelier
objects.description: Two rings of bulbs: bright, and a centrepiece.

objects.name: Industrial pendant
objects.description: An enamel factory shade on a chain.

objects.name: Ceiling fan
objects.description: Wooden blades and a light.

objects.name: Wall sconce
objects.description: A small shaded lamp for the wall.

objects.name: Swing-arm wall lamp
objects.description: A black gooseneck lamp for reading corners.

objects.name: Bulkhead light
objects.description: A caged wall light: indoors or on the outside of the house.

objects.name: Simple floor lamp
objects.description: A plain floor lamp.

objects.name: Table lamp
objects.description: A lamp on its own little table.

objects.name: Charcoal grill
objects.description: A kettle grill for the garden: dinner with smoke and a bit of fun. Trains Cooking.

objects.name: Gas grill station
objects.description: An outdoor kitchen with a hooded grill. From Cooking 3 a barbecue feast leaves residents with that home-cooked glow.

objects.name: Fire pit
objects.description: A ring of stones and a crackling fire. It lights the garden at night, and warming up by it leaves residents cosy.

objects.name: Folding bistro set
objects.description: A slatted folding table and chairs for a sunny corner.

objects.name: Picnic table
objects.description: A big wooden table with benches: picnics for two.

objects.name: Garden chair
objects.description: A deep slatted chair with wide arms.

objects.name: Sun lounger
objects.description: Stretch out in the sun, or doze off.

objects.name: Hammock
objects.description: A striped hammock on a wooden stand: swing, daydream, doze.

objects.name: Cedar hot tub
objects.description: A round wooden tub of hot water for two. A soak leaves residents pampered.

objects.name: Swing set
objects.description: Two swings on a wooden frame. Children love it; grown-ups sometimes have a go.

objects.name: Sandpit
objects.description: A wooden box of sand with a bucket and spade.

objects.name: Bike rack
objects.description: A rack with a bike in it. Tuning it up trains Handiness.

objects.name: Garden lamp post
objects.description: A lantern on a post to light the garden at night.

objects.name: String lights
objects.description: Festoon bulbs between two posts.
